records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the three and nine months ended September 30, 2022, we generated $198.1 million and $569.0 million in total revenue, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue mix for the three months ended September 30, 2022 was: cloud subscriptions 23%; software license 3%; maintenance 18%; services 52%; and hardware 4%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During this quarter, the US dollar strengthened materially against certain foreign currencies in markets in which we operate, particularly the Pound Sterling and the Euro, which negatively impacted total revenue and our remaining performance obligations (“RPO”) balance.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our R&D expenses were $29.4 million and $84.8 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three and nine months ended September 30, 2022, we generated cash flow from operating activities of $39.9 million and $124.4 million, respectively.
